Topics covered in this PDF

MPS-004 (Comparative Politics: Issues and Trends) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Almond's structural-functional approach, political economy and Wallerstein, theories of the origin of the state, the developing state and globalisation, civil society
  • Regional integration, international organisations, constitutionalism, party systems, nationalism, gender and development

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
